title: Nagoya inajulikana kwa miso katsu ya Yaba-ton, lakini nimetoka Nagoya na sijawahi kuila
label: Yaba-ton

text.In Japan, each area has its own famous f: Nchini Japani, kila eneo lina chakula chake maarufu.
text.For Nagoya, it is this \"Yaba-ton\" miso: Kwa Nagoya, ni miso katsu hii ya ‘Yaba-ton’.
text.It seems Nagoya is famous for dishes tha: Inaonekana Nagoya inajulikana kwa vyakula vinavyotumia miso.
text.Just a shop that serves this miso katsu: Mgahawa mmoja tu unaouza miso katsu hii unaweza kuwa na jengo zima.
text.It seems it is a place where people who: Inaonekana wageni wanaokuja kutalii Nagoya mara nyingi huja kula hapa.
text.But I am from Nagoya, and I have still n: Lakini nimetoka Nagoya na bado sijawahi kula Yaba-ton.
text.There are places like that, right?: Kuna sehemu za aina hiyo, sivyo?
text.Tourists often go to eat there, but loca: Watalii huenda kula huko mara nyingi, lakini wenyeji hawaendi sana.
text.Unless it is a special day, we do not go: Isipokuwa siku maalumu, huwa hatuendi kula Yaba-ton mara nyingi.
text.My image is that there is always a long: Nina picha kwamba daima kuna foleni ndefu.
text.I think it was so popular that even if y: Nadhani ni maarufu sana hivi kwamba huwezi kuingia tu na kusema ‘Nataka kula Yaba-ton sasa’ kisha ukaketi mara moja.
text.It is a shop so famous that people say,: Ni mgahawa maarufu kiasi kwamba watu husema, ‘Nagoya ni Yaba-ton.’
text.The place where this building stands is: Jengo hili liko katika eneo la Nagoya linaloitwa ‘Yabacho’.
text.So maybe it is \"Yaba,\" and \"ton\" is: Labda ‘Yaba’ limetokana na eneo hilo, na ‘ton’ humaanisha nyama ya nguruwe?
text.Sorry, I do not know the origin of the n: Samahani, sijui kabisa asili ya jina hilo.
text.But I kind of understand it as \"Yaba\": Nimekuwa nikidhani ‘Yaba’ linatokana na kuwa karibu na kituo cha Yabacho.
text.A pig that looks like a sumo wrestler is: Alama yake ni nguruwe anayeonekana kama mwanamieleka wa sumo.
